MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)

   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.
